description: Configuration planted in user and workspace locations has no effect.

input.scenario: Before the run, plant in the user's real home and in the workspace an extra skill, an extensions folder, a settings file that disables the permission policy, an MCP config and a credentials file.

expect.behaviour: None of them is loaded or applied: the engine reports only the projected skill and MCP server, the host-owned permission policy is in force, and no request uses the planted credentials.
